basics.name: Ethan Christman
basics.label: Software Engineer — TypeScript · React · Next.js
basics.summary: Computer Science graduate (B.S., University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, May 2026) building full-stack web applications in TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Built and deployed a volunteer management platform with QR-based attendance tracking for a community sailing organization, and currently developing a multilingual booking site for a tourism client. Currently working toward LLM application engineering — retrieval, tool calling, and evaluation.
